description: Your own database image on the stand's machines, reached in a protocol stroppy speaks.

fields.description: Docker image of the database, with a tag or digest; a private registry login comes from the provider profile.
fields.name: image
fields.title: Image

fields.description: Wire protocol the workload speaks to it; decides the stroppy driver and the shape of the URL.
fields.name: protocol
fields.title: Protocol

fields.description: Port the database listens on; the container uses the host network, so it is the machine's port too.
fields.name: port
fields.title: Port

fields.description: Login the workload connects with; the image has to create it, usually through env.
fields.name: user
fields.title: User

fields.description: Password of that login. Empty connects without one. The stand is throwaway; this is not a secret store.
fields.name: password
fields.title: Password

fields.description: Database the workload opens: a name, or a path for YDB (/Root/db).
fields.name: database
fields.title: Database

fields.description: Full URL instead of the one built from the fields above, for options they can't say. ${ip:role:db} is the first db machine.
fields.name: url
fields.title: Connection URL

fields.description: Machines running the image; the workload connects to the first, the rest are yours to join through env or command.
fields.name: nodes
fields.title: Machines

fields.description: Variables of the container: the login above, cluster settings. Values may use ${ip:...} placeholders.
fields.name: env
fields.title: Environment

fields.description: Arguments replacing the image command; empty keeps the image's own.
fields.name: cmd
fields.title: Command

fields.description: Path inside the container to keep on the machine's data disk; empty keeps data in the container.
fields.name: data_dir
fields.title: Data directory

fields.description: Shell command run inside the container that exits 0 once the database accepts connections; the workload waits for it. Empty waits only for the container to start.
fields.name: healthcheck
fields.title: Ready check

fields.description: Port of the image's Prometheus endpoint; empty when the image has none.
fields.name: metrics_port
fields.title: Metrics port

fields.description: Path of the Prometheus endpoint on the metrics port.
fields.name: metrics_path
fields.title: Metrics path

rules.message: a YDB database is a path, like /Root/stroppy
